MultiHead(Q, K, V) is computed as:
MultiHead(Q, K, V) = Concat(head_1, ..., head_h)W^O
where head_i = Attention(Q W_i^Q, K W_i^K, V W_i^V)

The system answer correctly defines the late-interaction operator as the sum of the maximum dot products between query and document embeddings.

rows.answer:
ColPali's late-interaction operator \( \text{LI}(q, d) \) is computed as the sum, over all query embedding vectors \( \mathbf{E_q}^{(i)} \), of their maximum dot product with each of the document embedding vectors \( \mathbf{E_d}^{(j)} \). Mathematically, it is defined as:

\[ \text{LI}(q, d) = \sum_{i \in [1, N_q]} \max_{j \in [1, N_d]} \langle \mathbf{E_q}^{(i)} | \mathbf{E_d}^{(j)} \rangle \]
